description: The templates a new report can be started from (such as Dashboard, Status update, Findings, Launch checklist and Blank), in the order a person is shown them. Each has an id, a name, one sentence on what it is for, guidance on what each part should hold, and the outline of its starting document (the kinds of its blocks, in order). Read the guidance before create_report.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
